scope: Signed-key floor row X decoding only; no fusion, map changes, routes, reference, or physical floor labels.
correction: signedY=key%100000; if signedY>=50000: signedY-=100000; x=(key-signedY)//100000. Only row X changed; all source grouping, medians, Y/Z, thresholds and least-squares algorithm unchanged.
limitations: Height shifts evaluate the same supplied-map nominal plane points, not measured floor elevations or recomputed cell assignments.
If the original recomputed R/t does not match supplied R/t within the predeclared tolerance, effects are isolated source-reconstruction effects, not causal attribution of the supplied map.
This does not determine a correct local floor, uncertainty, low-obstacle labels, or physical passage.
No native fusion or navigation was rerun.
